sloka: ततो नारायणेनोक्ता देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः ।सुरारींस्तान्हनिष्यामि सुरा भवत विज्वराः ।। ७.६.३२ ॥
transliteration: tato nārāyaṇenoktā devā indrapurogamāḥ ।surārīṁstānhaniṣyāmi surā bhavata vijvarāḥ ।। 7.6.32 ॥

translations.english: Having obtained the mantra from Hara and saluted Shiva, they reached the abode of Narayana and submitted everything to him.
